messages:
Priya Shah: Quick kickoff: need a scannable one-pager + short benchmark blurb + webinar sign-up flow for secure enterprise deploys. Audience: infra platform leads & security reviewers. No more than 48h turnaround.
Aisha Patel: Got it. Tone: prescriptive, not academic. One-pager: problem, solution, 3 bullet deploy decision guide, short SLA table, CTA to form.
Liam Chen: For benchmarks let's avoid absolute single numbers. Suggest ranges and a small note: 'typical p95 latency' and 'typical per-1k token cost'. Keep cache/autoscale impacts as % ranges.
Noor Ahmed: I'll ask runtime team for ranges: hosted p95, dedicated p95, private on-prem p95 + KV cache delta. ETA 6 hours.
Ben Morales: Routing: inbound leads with "private" or "VPC" in the form should create AE+SE ticket. Low-touch hosted interest goes to SDR nurture. OpsBot can we capture source param for campaign attribution?
OpsBot: Draft HubSpot form created: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/secure-deploy-launch (draft). Fields: Company, Role, DeployInterest (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), ComplianceNeeds, SLATarget, EstimatedQPS, Region, CampaignID. Workflow: Tagged AE_Private if DeployInterest=Private or ComplianceNeeds contains "hipaa"/"sox"/"fedramp".
Aisha Patel: Great. For the benchmark blurb copy: 2 short callouts: 1) "Reserved capacity yields predictable p95 latency and consistent throughput" 2) "KV caching & batching reduce steady-state token cost by 2-4x depending on workload". We'll caveat: results vary.
Liam Chen: Webinar: 30-40 min. Title idea: "Serving LLMs at Enterprise Scale: security, SLAs, and migration patterns." Format: 18m benchmarks + 12m migration demo + 10m AMA. Ask field for 1 customer quote.
Priya Shah: Collateral: one-pager PDF + single-slide benchmark graphic + 2 social cards. Design ask: Aisha, keep brand colors, use simple 2-axis plot (latency vs cost) with three markers: Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
Noor Ahmed: Runtime notes: KV cache gave median cost improvements of 2-3x on chat-style workloads in internal tests; dedicated autoscale reduces p95 by ~20-35% on bursty traffic. Will share exact ranges.
Ben Morales: SDR canned reply draft: "Thanks for reaching out — we'd love to learn more. Quick Qs: are you targeting VPC/private hosting, required SLA (p95), expected QPS, and any regulatory constraints? Here's a link to request a dedicated consult: https://redwood.ai/secure-deploy-request"
Aisha Patel: I'll draft the one-pager doc now and include the routing URL + form link + sample SLA table (Bronze/Silver/Gold SLOs).
Priya Shah: Legal note: include short line about data residency + KMS support + SOC2 / ISO certs. Keep legal copy tight.
Liam Chen: Distribution plan: publish one-pager -> email to pilot list -> LinkedIn + X organic + 2 targeted ads to infra leads -> webinar sign-ups. Ops: include campaign parameter for attribution (CampaignID).
OpsBot: Campaign stub: QC_SECUREDEPLOY_Q2, will append to form and social links.
Priya Shah: Final: owners - Aisha (copy+design), Noor (bench numbers + eng signoff), Ben (routing + SDR scripts), Liam (webinar ops). Target publish: 48 hours. Ping me when drafts are live.
Aisha Patel: Dropping draft doc here: https://docs.google.com/d/secure-deploy-onepager-draft-v2. I'll sync with design after Noor posts numbers.
Noor Ahmed: Posted numbers in the doc comments. Eng signoff pending small wording changes.
Priya Shah: Awesome. We'll do a short review after standup tomorrow. :rocket:
